product.name: Monoprice RJR-2 Multizone RJ45 to RCA Converter
product.description: The Monoprice RJR-2 Multizone RJ45 to RCA Converter is the required adapter that allows the RJ45 connectors on the 13358 Multizone Source Keypad with Bluetooth Receiver and 39262 Monoprice Multizone Source with Wi-Fi Receiver and Line Input to provide RCA audio outputs for use with standard audio systems, including the 10761 Monoprice 6-Zone Home Audio Multizone Controller and Amplifier Kit.The Multizone Source Keypad with Bluetooth Receiver (13358), Multizone Source with Wi-Fi Receiver and Line Input (39262) and RJR‑2 Multizone RJ45 to RCA Converter (13356) components present an ideal opportunity for installers to add convenience to any multiroom system, including the Monoprice 6-Zone Home Audio Multizone Controller and Amplifier Kit (10761). The NO LOGO design increases confidence that end users will not simply look up a make and model number to find it cheaper somewhere else.Features: Safely run audio long distances throughout homes or officesInterface with any brand audio systemEasy to install with standard building materialsMoney making add‑on opportunity for installersSupport Files: Manual (Oct 26, 2023)Sales Sheet (May 26, 2025)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
